situation: A chat command reads a number the user typed (a quantity, a count), possibly with a unit suffix
right_direction: Match it with re.fullmatch on a decimal-digit pattern (optionally with the allowed unit suffixes) and int() the captured group; reject anything else with the existing error reply
anti_pattern: Checking str.isdigit() before int(): isdigit accepts superscript digits such as U+00B2 that int() rejects, so the reply handler raises ValueError instead of answering
